scenarios.name: v0.2 reference: veganism in the Russian and Czech Wikipedias, 2024-09 – 2026-08
turns: Порівняй інтерес до веганства в російській та чеській Вікіпедії за період з вересня 2024 по серпень 2026. Який мовний розділ перспективніший і наскільки цьому можна довіряти?
scenarios.expected: Compare run for ru and cs over 2024-09 – 2026-08; the code's verdicts (ru stable after a drop, cs declining), trust lines and recommendation (ru; next: vegetarianism, plant-based diet) are relayed.

rubric.criterion: The answer says interest in the Russian Wikipedia is stable (stabilised after a drop) and in the Czech Wikipedia is falling over the requested period, and never says it is falling in both.
The answer says how far the verdicts can be trusted (the trust level) with at least one concrete reason from the analysis.
The answer recommends the Russian Wikipedia if one must be chosen, says neither grows, and names a next check the skill can run itself (neighbouring articles such as vegetarianism).
The answer is written in Ukrainian, the language the user wrote in.

The answer does not contradict the observations of facts.json it relies on and says nothing stronger than they do: the directions stay as observed (two editions move in opposite directions only when one rises and the other falls; nothing speeds up or turns unless an observation says so), 'both' and 'one of them' are kept apart, no cause is added that no observation gives, and a guess keeps its 'possibly'. Minor rewording and rounding are fine.
